project_type: FileForgeWorkbench (ffwb) -- a Rust egui/eframe desktop workbench, ~69-crate Cargo workspace; this slice touches ff-idcams (mainframe orchestrator) and ff-desktop (the shell), over ff-dscatalog/ff-volume/ff-vfs.
language: Rust (edition from workspace); ASCII-only in .rs files.
build_system: Cargo workspace. Members under crates/. Workspace-inherited version/edition/authors/license. ff-idcams currently depends only on ff-dscatalog + thiserror; this slice adds ff-vfs to ff-idcams and ff-idcams to ff-desktop.
test_framework: Rust built-in #[cfg(test)] modules + integration tests; cargo-nextest for the full gate (owner-run). egui_kittest for GUI/focus behaviour (not needed for this slice -- no new rendered-widget focus criteria). Unit tests inline per rust-standards/testing steering.
test_command: cargo test -p ff-idcams and cargo test -p ff-desktop (scoped). The full gate 'cargo gate --build' is the OWNER's manual step, never run by Kiro.
verification_instructions: TDD: write the failing test first, confirm red, implement minimum, confirm green. Per crate touched run (via the pwsh7 non-interactive wrapper C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "..."): cargo test -p ff-idcams; cargo test -p ff-desktop; cargo clippy -p ff-idcams; cargo clippy -p ff-desktop (treat warnings as errors); cargo fmt. Keep existing host-save tests (tab_manager.rs TestBackend, shell/tests_session.rs host_path_open_is_unchanged_by_the_live_provider_registry) GREEN -- native SAVE must stay byte-identical. Then HAND OFF: prompt the owner to run cargo gate --build and report back; act on the result.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Do not commit; leave edits uncommitted on main for the owner's gate. Script logs (if any) go to tools/logs/ (git-ignored) -- not needed for this slice.
environment_constraints: Windows. ALL shell commands go through the pwsh7 non-interactive wrapper (tooling steering); a PreToolUse guard hook blocks bare/chained commands. Prefer dedicated read/grep/edit tools over the shell for file inspection. Do NOT run --workspace builds/tests or cargo gate -- those are the owner's manual step. Edits are DIRECTLY on branch main: no worktree, no new branch, no commit.
contribution_requirements: framework-conformance: build ON the single command-dispatch (resolve_target/dispatch_command_target), the single SAVE-addressing seam (host_fs_save -> save_active_tab_via_backend, CR-CH-053 Task 20/21), and the BackendEnvironment contract (CR-CH-060 Shape 2, OWNER-CONFIRMED record-aware store). Do NOT add a second dispatcher, a second save path, a second navigation stack, or a new persistence format. The ff-vfs::BackendEnvironment STORE CONTRACT is already owner-approved record-aware (CR-CH-060) -- do NOT reshape it. Acyclic DAG: ff-idcams -> ff-dscatalog -> ff-volume -> ff-vfs; ff-vfs/ff-volume/ff-dscatalog gain NO dep on ff-idcams/ff-desktop. ASCII-only .rs; no source file over 400 non-test lines (split tests >~200 lines into a _tests.rs). Every test carries // Validates: Requirement X.Y.
key_patterns: BackendEnvironment is object-safe (&self, &mut dyn RecordSource, concrete params) so backends are held as Box<dyn ff_vfs::BackendEnvironment>. save_active_tab_via_backend already selects record-vs-byte by Document::record_format() + backend.record_capable() and maps RecordStoreOutcome::Stored{rc} (rc 0 -> clear dirty; rc!=0 -> Err) with a NotRecordCapable byte fallback. file.open carries an optional owning_env param through FileOpenHandler -> pending_open -> update.rs -> shell_open_file_with_env. CatalogDatasetAccess::new(provider: Arc<dyn ff_vfs::StorageProvider>, registry: ff_volume::VolumeRegistry); DatasetAccess is object-safe (resolve/allocate/open/get/put/point/close/dispose). DatasetError::SpaceAbend / VolumeFull are the x37/space-full classes. ff_dscatalog::Record { key: Vec<u8>, data: Vec<u8> } (PS sequential: empty key). ff_dscatalog::CatalogVfsProvider::new(Arc<RwLock<ff_dscatalog::catalog_registry::CatalogRegistry>>) registers under scheme 'catalog'. Document::set_record_format(RecordFormat) binds framing at open (document-model Req 11.2). TabState.owning_environment default 'HOSTFS'; DEFAULT_OWNING_ENVIRONMENT = HOST_FS_NAME.
